slides.texte_overlay:
5 hobbies that make life so
full you forget to scroll

evening walks

walk for half an hour every evening after dinner. watching the light change and the streets go quiet is so much more relaxing than any screen will ever be.

a weekly class

sign up for one weekly class: pottery, dance, a language. having something you look forward to every week quietly fills the space scrolling used to take.

a lesson before bed

spend 5 minutes before bed learning one calm new thing: a myth, a planet, an artist. it's the gentlest way to end the day without reaching for your feed.
slides.texte_sophia:
a lesson before bed

i spend 5 minutes before bed on one calm lesson: a myth, a planet, an artist. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and it ends my day without reaching for the feed.

slides.texte_overlay:
cooking new recipes

cook one new recipe every weekend, with music instead of videos. making something real with your hands is deeply satisfying in a way scrolling never is.

a growing bookshelf

buy or borrow one good book a month and keep it on your bedside table. when a good book is always within reach, your phone becomes so much less tempting.
